description: This PHP class 'EmployeeTimeAtWorkService' provides methods for managing and retrieving employee time tracking data, including calculating work hours, retrieving last punch-in/out actions, and aggregating weekly data. It interacts with data access objects and other services to process attendance records within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkService
classes.description: Service class for managing employee time tracking, including calculating weekly and daily work hours, last punch actions, and aggregating data for display and analysis.

methods.name: getTimeAtWorkResults
methods.description: Fetches weekly data and metadata about employee's work hours for a given date context.

methods.name: getDataForCurrentWeek
methods.description: Retrieves daily work hours and total for the current week, starting from the week's boundary.

methods.name: getLastActionDetails
methods.description: Gets details of the last punch-in or punch-out action performed by the employee.

methods.name: getTotalTimeForGivenDate
methods.description: Calculates total work time in minutes for a specific date, optionally considering ongoing attendance.

methods.name: getDateDetails
methods.description: Returns formatted date information including date string and label for a DateTime object.

methods.name: getTimeInHoursAndMinutes
methods.description: Converts total minutes into hours and minutes for display.

methods.name: getDateTimeInUTC
methods.description: Converts a DateTime object to UTC timezone.

methods.name: getTimeDifference
methods.description: Calculates the difference in minutes between two DateTime objects.

methods.name: getCurrentUserData
methods.description: Retrieves current user's employee data including name and termination info.
